property_summary: After initialize sets changeFee to 0 (bug) vs _changeFee (correct), flashFee (which returns changeFee) returns 0 instead of the intended value, and availableForFlashLoan returns false because the owner check is on a non-existent token, so the test asserts that flashFee returns the correct non-zero value from a properly initialized pool.
change_summary: Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = 0;` so changeFee is always zero after initialization.
